title: Examples / Paid media

location.series: IBM Logo Guidelines for Strategic Partners / Version 1.2 / copyright 2023

slide_intent: Adapt brand hierarchy to advertisement proportions so ownership remains clear in both wide and tall formats.
strategic_value: Consistent partner prominence can make IBM support recognizable across varied paid placements.
demonstration: A horizontal banner and vertical ad pair partner branding with gray content fields, blue CTA elements and smaller IBM marks.
practical_value: Adjust the composition to the ad format while preserving the partner-led hierarchy and distinct CTA.

content_islands.name: Horizontal ad
content_islands.spec: Show the wide banner at left with content and CTA on one side and the partner brand field on the other.

content_islands.name: Vertical ad
content_islands.spec: Show the tall format at right with partner branding above and content, IBM acknowledgement and CTA below.

content_islands.name: Qualification
content_islands.spec: Retain the note that layout options are not restricted to these examples.

reference_purposes.Application: The paired schematics apply partner-led hierarchy to horizontal and vertical paid media.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The caption explicitly states that the illustrated layouts are not exhaustive.
